note: Keyword sets for X recent search. Narrative-first: topics only, never accounts (from:, to: and @ are refused). A set runs only when its status is 'approved' by the NPCC Comms lead (workflow step W1.1). Queries use X search syntax; recent search covers the last 7 days.

sets.label: Fake police notices and curfews
sets.query: (police OR constabulary) (curfew OR "fake notice" OR "fake letter" OR "not from us") lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: Spiking claims
sets.query: (spiked OR spiking OR "injection spiking") (club OR bar OR freshers OR uni) lang:en -is:retweet

sets.label: Fake police fine texts
sets.query: ("police fine" OR "speeding fine" OR "penalty notice") (text OR sms OR scam) lang:en -is:retweet
